QuestInfo.name: Featherweights 2
QuestInfo.0: Icebyrd looks like he needs my help. I'd better get over to New Leaf City and see him!
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Icebyrd, and he was glad to see me. He's been trying to build the new areas, but the #o9400544#s have been wreaking havoc on the construction crews. I've agreed to help by taking out #b100 #o9400547#s#k (located in the Jungle Clearing).
QuestInfo.2: Man, what a day. I de-clawed the #o9400544#s. Now the city can continue building in peace. Icebyrd said that they may act up again, so I should come back to see if they've been rowdy...

0.0: So glad to see you! I need your help!

yes.0: Perfect! We're building the new areas, but we've come under attack from #o9400544#s, who are damaging my machinery! It's madness! I'll need you to kick some booty - #b100 #o9400544#s#k. You do that for me, and I won't forget it!

no.0: Guess we'll have to get it done without you then...

1.0: Nice, nice. You got skills, I recognize that.

yes.0: Here's a little something for your trouble. Even though you beat them back, they'll be back. See me when you're ready for action!

mob.0: You got jokes, I see. That's funny, cause I know I said beat #b100 #o9400544#s#k. Not 'way less than that'. Do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth? Get to it!
